## Loneliness

- Feeling of being isolated
- Associated with worsening in physical and mental health
- Urgent social problem even more in COVID context
- Spain one of the most restrictive lockdown

::: notes
- [1]Lon. is a feeling of bein /ai/solated
- [2]is associated with worsening in /fi/sical and mental health
- [3]it was a social emergency due to the covid /nineteen/ and 
- [4]Spain had one of the most restrictive lockdowns
:::

## Aims

- Study the change in loneliness (UCLA scale) before and during the lockdown 
- And the factors associated with this change

::: notes
- The principal /e/ims are to study the change in loneliness COMPILE with the UCLA scale before and during the lockdowm
- [2] And study which factors are associated associated with these changes
:::

## Sample

- n = 1002
- 18+ from regions of Madrid and Barcelona
- Project: Edad con Salud
- Recruited following a multistage stratified design

::: notes
- [1]We have a sample of 1002 participans and 
- [2] they were over 18 years old.
- [3]These are part for the refreshment sample of the Edad con Salud project
:::

## Sociodemographic variables

- Age grouped 
- Sex
- Marital status
- Education level

::: notes
The soc. dem. that we take into account are...
:::

## Covariates (Scales)

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
- Social relationships 
- A worsening in economy
- Living alone
- Resilience (BRS)
- Neuroticism (EPQR-A)
- Extraversion (EPQR-A)
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
- Physical activity (GPAQ)
- Disability (WHO-DAS II)
- Anxiety (GAD - CIDI 3)
- Panic (PAN - CIDI 3)
- Depression before (CIDI 3)
- Depression during (CIDI 3)
:::

::::

::: notes
- We take into account three variables related to the covid
- and some valid mental health tests
:::

# Parameter estimation

- Characterization of Loneliness 
  - Mixed model `lme4::lmer` to estimate means and CI
  - `Loneliness ~ 0 + Assessment*factor + (1|ID)`
- Regression Multivariate 
  - General linear model `survey::svyglm` to estimate beta, CI and p values
  - `Loneliness_before ~ offset(Loneliness_before) + factors`

::: footer
To improve the representativeness, sampling weights were generated according to the sex, age and city.
:::


::: notes
- We fit the data with the mixed model for...
- Next I will present the results of the demograp and the covariates with the most relevant changes in loneliness.
:::

# Multivariate regression

## Multivariate {.scrollable}

![](multi.png)
<!-- Example -->

::: notes
- [0] There are not important changes in the sociod
- [1] but in the separated group of marital status we have a significant change in lon.
- [3] Next, the group of social relationship felt more lone. and is more significant when the soc. rel. have worsened
- [4] And we found something interesting about the neuroticism...the more neuroticism a person shows the less loneliness they felt.
- [5] And last, we can see the depression is significant when is tested during the lockdown
:::

## Conclusion

- There are changes in loneliness that could be due to the effect of lockdown
- The most important factors related to change of loneliness are social relationships, neuroticism and depression during the lockdown

::: notes
- We can deepen in these factors in the future
:::
